servinfo.title: Audio System Symptom Diagnosis
servinfo.ptxt: Before performing the following troubleshooting, check if the symptom is not caused by incorrect handling while referring to Owner’s Manual.
If the cause cannot be identified by the following troubleshooting, replace audio unit with a known-good one. If the symptom is cleared, audio unit is the cause.

action.ptxt: Check audio connectors for connection.

ps.ptxt: Faulty audio power supply and ground circuits (including fuse)

action.ptxt: Refer to Audio System Circuit Diagram and Inspection of Audio System and Its Circuit .
Check radio antenna connectors for connection.
Substitute a known-good radio antenna and recheck reception.
Refer to Radio Antenna Feeder Cable Inspection .

ps.ptxt: Faulty radio antenna power supply circuit

action.ptxt: Refer to Audio System Circuit Diagram and Inspection of Audio System and Its Circuit .
Check speaker connectors for connection.
Refer to Audio System Circuit Diagram and Inspection of Audio System and Its Circuit .

condition.ptxt: Light mode does not change when lighting switch is turned on

ps.ptxt: Faulty illumination power supply and ground circuits (including fuse)

action.ptxt: Refer to Audio System Circuit Diagram and Inspection of Audio System and Its Circuit .

condition.ptxt: Audio system is operative, but audio control switch does not control audio system

action.ptxt: Check steering switch connectors for connection.
Refer to Steering Switch (Audio Control Switch and Hands-Free Switch) Inspection (If Equipped) .
Refer to Audio System Circuit Diagram .

condition.ptxt: Impossible to call using hands-free system (if equipped)

action.ptxt: Check microphone connectors for connection.
Refer to Inspection of Audio System and Its Circuit .
Refer to Audio System Circuit Diagram .
Check steering switch connectors for connection.
Refer to Steering Switch (Audio Control Switch and Hands-Free Switch) Inspection (If Equipped) .
Refer to Audio System Circuit Diagram .

condition.ptxt: Rearview image does not come out even when shift lever is shifted to reverse position (if equipped)

ps.ptxt: Rearview image signal from rearview camera inputted incorrectly

action.ptxt: Check rearview camera circuit.
Check reverse position signal circuit.

ps.ptxt: Abnormal operating environments such as temperature, radio waves, etc.

action.ptxt: Recheck in different place.
Replace rearview camera.
Replace audio unit.

condition.ptxt: Rearview image vibrates too much, or looks different from usual cases (if equipped)

action.ptxt: Check installation status.
Replace audio unit.

condition.ptxt: USB device connected to USB socket is not recognized by audio unit (if equipped)

ps.ptxt: Faulty USB and AUX harness connector

action.ptxt: Check USB and AUX harness connectors for connection.
Refer to USB and AUX Harness Inspection (If Equipped) .
Refer to USB and AUX Socket Inspection (If Equipped) .
Refer to Audio System Circuit Diagram and Inspection of Audio System and Its Circuit .

condition.ptxt: AUX device connected to AUX socket is not recognized by audio unit (if equipped)

ps.ptxt: Faulty USB and AUX harness connector

action.ptxt: Check USB and AUX harness connectors for connection.
Refer to USB and AUX Harness Inspection (If Equipped) .
Substitute a known-good USB and AUX socket and recheck reception.
Refer to Audio System Circuit Diagram and Inspection of Audio System and Its Circuit .
